info.title: mcpmysite
info.description: Command-line indexer: crawls a website and builds a search index for the MCP my site server.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Crawls a website and builds the search index served by the MCP my site server.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Builds the index. Every run is a full rebuild.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to appsettings.json. appsettings.{Environment}.json next to it is applied on top. [default: appsettings.json]

options.name: --environment
options.description: Environment name (default: DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT, ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT, then Production).

options.name: --folder
options.description: Index a local folder of built HTML instead of crawling.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Writes a starter appsettings.json with every setting and its default.

options.name: --config
options.description: Where to write the file. [default: appsettings.json]

options.name: --keyword-only
options.description: Sets Embeddings:Enabled to false: keyword search only, no embeddings provider or API key needed. [default: False]

arguments.name: SITE_URL
arguments.description: Base URL of the site, e.g. https://example.com

commands.name: search
commands.description: Runs a query against a built index. Handy for checking an index before deploying it.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to appsettings.json. appsettings.{Environment}.json next to it is applied on top. [default: appsettings.json]

options.name: --environment
options.description: Environment name (default: DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT, ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT, then Production).

options.name: --index
options.description: Index directory. Defaults to Output:Directory from the config, else ./index.

options.name: --keyword-only
options.description: Skip the embedding call and run keyword search only. [default: False]
